rationale: Chamber directory mapping donor procurement entry points for UA — mine once for portal leads, not a recurring signal producer.
One analytical post mapping IFI-financed UA procurement channels (Prozorro, RELINK, DREAM); harvest the named portals, then archive.
Commercial donor-tender aggregator useful as cross-check, but reuse terms unclear and full records are typically gated — human must clear access/licensing.
Recurring official monthly IFI-assistance series gives funding context ahead of procurement, but URL verification failed and exact series feed needs re-checking.
Single 2023 press release, but the canonical statement of MDB harmonised procurement rules that routes UA donor contracts — keep as reference evidence.
TED is the canonical EU notice/award channel capturing Ukraine-linked banking and payments contracts; durable standalone monitoring target.
TED Search API docs enable a durable machine-readable feed rather than ad-hoc lookups; standalone technical source worth tracking for schema changes.
SIMAP legal-basis page sits on ted.europa.eu and adds interpretive context only; covered by monitoring TED itself.
SEDIA portal carries Commission/DG-level calls (incl. DG NEAR UA financial-sector TA) with richer docs than the OJ notice; distinct standalone feed.
DG NEAR grants-and-tenders hub is the contracting route for most EU assistance to Ukraine; continuously republishes calls and awards.
Ukraine Facility hub gives the funding envelope and reform milestones that lead procurement notices; updated programme page, useful as leading indicator.
EEAS tender listing surfaces below-threshold EU delegation contracts in Ukraine (cash handling, IT, banking services) that never reach TED.
EUAM Ukraine runs its own in-country mission procurement outside TED; small but distinct channel naming Ukrainian vendors as awardees.
EU-funded digital ID / Diia procurement page is squarely in-scope adjacent infrastructure, but URL verification failed — recheck liveness before approval.
Regional EU opportunities feed aggregates Eastern Partnership project tenders incl. EU4DigitalUA; recurring hub for discovering implementers.
ECEPP publishes EBRD-financed UA notices and awards incl. financial-sector work, but full notice access typically requires registration.
EIB press/project stream names UA counterparties and on-lending banks ahead of notices; monitor the press feed rather than this single release.
Static official explainer of how UA firms access EU tenders under GPA — valuable reference on terminology and legal basis, not a recurring feed.
Single Prozorro knowledge-base article explaining which Ukraine Facility contracts land in Prozorro vs TED; key de-duplication reference.
Dedicated donor-procurement news stream on the official Prozorro portal; recurring bridge between national and EU/IFI channels.
Commercial TED mirrors add no authoritative content over TED itself, with low credibility and unclear reuse terms — redundant.
Bulk historical TED datasets enable retrospective Ukraine/bank award analysis, but this catalogue mirror's provenance and licence need checking.
Treasury transaction register is ground truth on who was actually paid for ATM/POS/processing goods and services in Ukraine, incl. recurring maintenance.
Spending open API is the backbone for longitudinal vendor-payment tracking; URL verification failed, so confirm endpoint version before approving.
